name: korean-pim
description: Adjudication library for the 2018 Korean potentially inappropriate medication (PIM) criteria: all 63 Table 1 items and all 18 Table 2 condition rules (102 unique items), WHO ATC mapping, verification against the source article, and comparison with the 2022 HIRA national standard. Deterministic rules, no dependencies.

scripts.test: node test/test.js && node test/verify_against_paper.js && node test/test_bitmask.js
